scope: Internal comparison of redundant source products, not independent vendor export/physical calibration validation. No raw arrays or calibrated axis changed.
physical_energy_units_status: Inferred: apparent keV-like reference/window values and eV-like values after multiplication by 1000.

model.limitation: Source-only zero is approximate. Carbon-trained corrections are fitted diagnostics. Identical complete spectra/live can yield different source image values, so an exact position-invariant operator using only those inputs is ruled out. Missing processing history/state/precision mechanism remains unresolved.

sampling.generalization: Source formula chosen using earlier carbon work. All 13 noncarbon windows/map withheld from carbon zero fitting. Products share source acquisition and are not independent references.
